title: Final85 terminal-state verification
root_cause: The interrupted final85 campaign could otherwise be mistaken for a resumable or partially certifying run.
source_requirement: Prove final85 is terminal, preserve its evidence, and forbid resume/retry.
implementation_steps: Inspect campaign identity and stage states.
Verify apply_count is one and terminal state is failed.
Record that no later stage ran.
negative_cases: Do not infer certification from green section receipts.
Do not resume or retry final85.
evidence_required: Terminal campaign identity, state, stage denominator, and source/release hashes.
rollback: Evidence-only card; preserve the prior campaign and remove only erroneous new audit projection.
acceptance_criteria: final85 is recorded terminal with resume_or_retry_allowed=false.
